products.name: The CITIZEN
products.bracelet: Crocodile, Fold Over Clasp with Push Buttons
products.description: Superior precision meets the highest standards of quality in The CITIZEN. Representing the never-ending pursuit of the essence of the watch, this exceptional Super Titanium™ timepiece serves as the ideal all-purpose timepiece, perfectly balancing mechanical refinement with aesthetic intrigue. The CITIZEN watches are crafted in a dedicated workshop deep in the Nagano countryside, where extraordinary skill is essential for their highly advanced movements. This meticulous work is entrusted to our watchmaking Meisters, our most experienced and technically proficient artisans. With precision and care, they bring each timepiece to life, making every watch a true reflection of fine craftsmanship. The ultraprecise Citizen Calibre A060 movement was developed using only the most rigorously selected crystal oscillators and is assembled from individual components of extraordinary precision. With an annual accuracy of ±5 seconds, the crystal oscillators were set aside for a six-month observation period before selecting only those that meet our high standards of accuracy. The unique dial of this limited-edition timepiece features a special design inspired by ""Makura no Soshi” from The Pillow Book by Sei Shōnagon, a classic work of Japanese literature. On the wrist, the watch measures comfortably at 38.3mm, with its gold-tone Super Titanium™ case that’s lightweight, scratch- and rust-resistant, and faceted with sharp surfaces of brushed and polished finishing and secured via a brown crocodile leather strap. A dual-sphere sapphire crystal protects a rich brown eagle feather pattern dial, creating a captivating interplay between light, texture, and colour. Toward the bottom of the display is an eagle mark, symbolizing the twin ideals of The CITIZEN – foresight and dedication to the pursuit of ideals, as well as the enduring connection between watch and wearer. Equipped with our proprietary Eco-Drive technology that's sustainably powered by any light and never needs a battery, advanced features include a perpetual calendar, power reserve, time difference correction, and a midnight sharp calendar update function. Water resistant up to 100 metres. Limited to 400 unnumbered pieces worldwide.

The scratch-resistant Attesa is sustainably light-powered by Citizen’s proprietary Eco-Drive technology, so it never needs a battery. Water resistant up to 100 meters. Caliber F950.

A black leather strap with red contrast stitching complete the look. Check out the retro-style suitcase on the dial and etched on the case back: it now has four stickers! Also on the case back are etched “Time to Fly” and “Since 1928”—the year Mickey Mouse first graced the silver screen. And this blockbuster timepiece is sustainably powered by any light with Eco-Drive and never needs a battery.

products.name: Sorcerer's Apprentice Mickey
products.bracelet: Stainless Steel, Fold Over Clasp
products.description: One of the most exciting adventures of the 1940s soon became the making of the Walt Disney Animation film, Fantasia, and the breakthroughs in color, sound, and motion. A magical Sorcerer Mickey waves his wand, and POOF, the Arabic markers turn to Roman on the dark of night dial. This Disney x Citizen watch features an incredibly detailed dial within a two-tone stainless-steel case and bracelet. Powered by any light with Eco-Drive technology, this watch never needs a battery.

products.name: Sensational Six Road Trip
products.bracelet: Leather, Buckle
products.description: Known by Disney fans as the Disney's Mickey and Friends, Mickey Mouse, Minnie Mouse, Donald Duck, Daisy Duck, Goofy, and Pluto are traversing the U.S.A. in this new watch sustainably fueled by any light with Eco-Drive technology. Featuring a tour-de-force design from Disney artists John and Shelley Loter, the brushed silver dial showcases the free-wheeling friends in a snazzy red convertible en route to adventure. One clue about their travel plans? Check out the Route 6 sign marker at the bottom of the dial–an historic highway that stretches 3,200 miles from California to Massachusetts. This unisex style features a 40mm silver-tone stainless steel case and a textured black leather strap, making it a hard-driving accessory for work, weekends, or, of course, roadtripping holidays.

products.name: TSUYOSA Mickey Mouse
products.bracelet: Stainless Steel, Fold Over Clasp with Push Buttons
products.description: Spring into action with the new TSUYOSA Mickey Mouse, an automatic sports watch. Our TSUYOSA collection is characterized by colorful dials, and in this new style we see jumping-for-joy Mickey Mouse in the center of a sky blue sunray dial with tooled hands while three tilted numeric markers suggest his energy and bouncy motion. The substantial faceted silver-tone stainless steel 40mm case and brushed and polished integrated bracelet make an elegant statement, and the open case back reveals the 21-jewel movement. Designed for both Disney devotees and fans of fine craftsmanship, this fan-favorite timepiece is built to last.

products.name: TSUYOSA Minnie Mouse
products.bracelet: Stainless Steel, Fold Over Clasp with Push Buttons
products.description: Dance through the hours with the new TSUYOSA Minnie Mouse. Disney Minnie Mouse takes center stage on a pink sunray dial as she gracefully points out the time with her tooled hands with signature gloved hands. The faceted silver-tone stainless steel 40mm case and brushed and polished integrated bracelet are at once sleek, chic, and sporty, making it a watch for all occasions, and the open case back reveals the 21-jewel movement. Made to delight Disney fans and connoisseurs of advanced design alike, this special timepiece will be cherished for a lifetime.

products.name: TSUYOSA Mickey Mouse and Minnie Mouse
products.bracelet: Stainless Steel, Fold Over Clasp with Push Buttons
products.description: Celebrate every moment with the TSUYOSA Mickey Mouse & Minnie Mouse. Spring into action and dance through the hours with this dynamic duo from our TSUYOSA collection, renowned for its colorful dials and bold automatic design. Mickey jumps for joy on a sky-blue sunray dial, while Minnie takes center stage on a pink sunray dial, gracefully pointing out the time with her signature gloved hands. Each watch features tooled hands and tilted numeric markers that capture their lively energy. The substantial 40mm faceted silver-tone stainless steel cases and brushed and polished integrated bracelets deliver a sleek, sporty elegance, while the open case backs reveal the 21-jewel automatic movement. Designed to delight Disney fans and connoisseurs of fine craftsmanship alike, this collectible set is built to last—and made to share.

products.description: Designed for maximum versatility – the Tsuyosa Small Second Automatic interchangeable strap includes a range of 22MM leather straps designed to transition easily from elevated to classic. These proprietary straps are only interchangeable with Tsuyosa Small Second Automatic styles NK5010-51L, NK5010-51X and NK5010-01H.

products.name: Khaki Leather Strap
products.description: Designed for maximum versatility – the Tsuyosa Small Second Automatic interchangeable strap includes a range of 22MM leather straps designed to transition easily from elevated to classic. These proprietary straps are only interchangeable with Tsuyosa Small Second Automatic styles NK5010-51L, NK5010-51X and NK5010-01H.

products.name: Blue Leather Strap
products.description: Designed for maximum versatility – the Tsuyosa Small Second Automatic interchangeable strap includes a range of 22MM leather straps designed to transition easily from elevated to classic. These proprietary straps are only interchangeable with Tsuyosa Small Second Automatic styles NK5010-51L, NK5010-51X and NK5010-01H.

products.name: Darth Maul
products.bracelet: Stainless Steel, Sliding Safety Clasp
products.description: Imagine being seduced by the power of the dark side with the Darth Maul watch, evoking the powerful and daring nature of the infamous warrior with a striking, eye-catching design. Part of the Star Wars™ | Citizen Tsuno Collection, the design incorporates the distinctive red and black markings of Darth Maul’s unforgettable likeness and yellow “horns” on the dial, push buttons, and crown. Offset by an ion-plated stainless steel case, this collector’s timepiece features a 1-second chronograph, a convenient date display, and black ion-plated stainless steel band. The case back features the iconic Star Wars logo and etching of Darth Maul himself. This watch is part of our exclusive collection that features 4 timepieces, each with a vintage design inspired by Citizen’s famed 1972 model known as the Tsuno Chrono, thanks to tsuno “horns” placed on both sides of the 12 o’clock position. This watch requires a battery. Caliber number 0510.

products.name: Drive
products.bracelet: Leather, Buckle
products.description: The new Drive from Citizen AR, a laid back feel with classic structure, instantly adding style to any wardrobe. In dark gray ion-plated stainless steel case with gray chroma finishing, light brown strap and black dial with chronograph and 12/24-hour time. Featuring our Eco-Drive technology – powered by light, any light. Never needs a battery. Caliber number H500.

products.name: Classic LIGHT in BLACK
products.bracelet: Stainless Steel, Fold Over Clasp with Push Buttons
products.description: Blending refined styling with bold contrasts, the Limited Edition Dress Classic brings a celestial-inspired touch to the modern chronograph. Sustainably powered by any light with our proprietary Eco-Drive technology, this timepiece never needs a battery. A 42mm gray-tone stainless steel case houses the design, with stepped pushers underscoring its contemporary sport-luxury profile. On the black dial, yellow gold-tone accents highlight the sub-dials, applied markers, and hands, while a discreet date display ensures daily utility. A sapphire crystal protects the dial, and a five-link bracelet secures the watch to the wrist. Water resistant up to 100 meters. Caliber H504. Limited to 6,000 unnumbered pieces worldwide.

products.name: The Fantastic 4: First Steps
products.bracelet: Super Titanium, Fold Over Clasp with Push Buttons
products.description: Limited-Edition model. That super group of Super Heroes, the Fantastic 4, developed their superpowers after being exposed to cosmic rays in outer space. This new limited-edition timepiece pays tribute to Mister Fantastic, the Invisible Woman, the Torch, and Thing with a stunning blue dial featuring a vertical brush pattern, applied white lume markers, and a wavy 12 o’clock marker that symbolizes Reed Richards’ ability to stretch his body into incredible shapes. The case back features the team’s striking logo, which is repeated on the collectible coin that comes with this boxed set. And making this timepiece even more powerful? The Zenshin silver-tone case and bracelet are crafted from Citizen’s proprietary Super Titanium™ that’s five times harder and 40% lighter than stainless steel as well as being hypoallergenic and scratch- and rust-resistant. Sustainably powered by any light with Citizen’s Eco-Drive technology, this watch never needs a battery. © 2025 MARVEL

products.name: Duel 2.0
products.bracelet: Leather, Buckle
products.description: Sustainably powered by any light with Eco-Drive technology, this cinematic timepiece showcases the final scene of the archetypal battle between the light and dark sides on Cloud City. The brushed stainless-steel 42mm case encircles a dramatic black dial that depicts Luke Skywalker standing alone in silhouette surrounded by blue luminous details, including lume-filled blue and red hands representing the victor’s and Darth Vader’s lightsabers. These colors also appear as strap keepers on the black watch band, and the iconic weapons are etched on the case back along with the immortal quote, “It is your destiny.” This artistically designed and well-crafted timepiece makes a fitting Father’s Day gift or a cherished collectible for ultimate Star Wars fans.

products.name: Duel
products.bracelet: Stainless Steel, Fold Over Clasp with Push Buttons
products.description: Not everyone belongs to the dark side of the Force, and sometimes a battle has no winners. Representing one of the most epic lightsaber duels in the Star Wars™ galaxy, the struggle between Luke Skywalker™ and Darth Vader™ on Cloud City was pivotal to their family struggle. This Citizen and Star Wars original timepiece features a silver-tone stainless steel case and bracelet on a black outlined dial with green pops of color and blue and red markers. The highlight is the dial’s bold graphic center recreating the famous duel with neon-colored hands symbolizing the lightsabers. The case back is etched with Vader’s striking line from Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back™, “I find your lack of faith disturbing.” For Star Wars and Citizen fans alike, this collector’s timepiece is powered with our proprietary Eco-Drive technology that converts energy from any light and never needs a battery. Water resistance to 200 meters. Caliber J810.

products.name: Drive
products.bracelet: Stainless Steel, Fold Over Clasp with Push Buttons
products.description: An edgy structure in a classic setting, this Drive from Citizen WDR watch features a deep gray ion-plated stainless steel case and bracelet with a denim blue dial and date. Featuring our Eco-Drive technology – powered by light, any light. Never needs a battery. Caliber number J810.

products.name: Loki
products.bracelet: Leather, Buckle
products.description: Marvel Studios’ Loki is here with the latest Marvel Studios timepiece from Citizen. This striking timepiece features a rose gold-tone stainless steel case, with faceted lugs connecting to a deep green crocodile-textured strap, and a case back featuring the Time Variance Authority icon. At the center of the 3-hand dial, a rose gold-tone Loki helmet graphic is bold against a deep green background, with the color of the horned helmet complemented by matching details in the scaled hour markers, date window, and periphery details. The sleek watch is powered by Citizen’s proprietary Eco-Drive technology - powered by any light, and never needs a battery.

products.name: Boba Fett
products.bracelet: Nylon, Buckle
products.description: The OG Mandalorian returns in this new watch that’s sustainably powered by any light with Eco-Drive and never needs a battery. A genetic clone of his adopted father Jango Fett, Boba Fett was destined to become one of the most fearsome bounty hunters in the Galactic Empire. Within the 44mm silver-tone, brushed stainless steel case, the distinctive dial is composed of colors from his formidable armor, with a mythosaur beast from his home planet of Mandalore at 12 o’clock and his helmet at the center, along with luminous hands and markers. The combat-ready olive green Cordura nylon strap with patterning completes the look, and the stainless steel case back is engraved with Bobafett's starship Slave I. From Tatooine to the Outer Rim, this watch is built for those who live by their own code–and appreciate rugged style.

products.name: Wolverine
products.bracelet: Stainless Steel, Fold Over Clasp with Push Buttons
products.description: SNIKT! The first X-Men watch in the Marvel | Citizen Collection is Wolverine (alias: Logan, birth name: James Howlett). This ageless mutant with animal senses, super-human strength, and healing powers is dramatically represented on the blue dial by his lethal retractable claws that are fully luminous. A yellow outer ring, silver-tone markers, and luminous hands and the X-Men logo at 12 o’clock complete the striking look. The case back is etched with the Wolverine logo and “SNIKT!,” the fearsome sound of his claws busting out. The 43mm case and bracelet are fashioned from black ion-plated stainless steel (not adamantium, which is fictional), and the boxed set comes with a matching collectible pin. Unlike Wolverine, who can be fueled by berserker rage, this watch is powered by light with Eco-Drive technology and never needs a battery. © 2023 MARVEL

products.name: Death Star, Vader's Shadow
products.bracelet: Silicone, Buckle
products.description: The foreboding power of the Dark Side is perfectly expressed in the new Death Star, Vader’s Shadow timepiece. With a dark-toned, imposing 45mm brushed finish black ion-plated stainless steel case and a deep black dial that perfectly frames the fearsome Galactic Empire space station that’s capable of destroying entire planets and features shadows of the Imperial symbol and Darth Vader. The watch is accentuated by illuminated features on the dial and bezel, along with a red second hand. Etched on the case back is another perspective of the Death Star, and the watch is finished with a textured black silicone strap. Dark it may be, but this singular watch is sustainably powered by any light with Citizen’s proprietary Eco-Drive technology and never needs a battery.

products.name: Spider-Man
products.bracelet: Leather, Buckle
products.description: Celebrating Classic Super Hero Spider-Man, the Citizens men’s watch is sure to be make every fan feel AMAZING! The stainless steel case uniquely features the date and crown at 4 o’clock and has an iconic red dial with blue accents. The Eco-Drive, light-powered watch features luminous hands and the date, and is finished off with a blue leather perforated strap that completes the character’s look. This Spider-Man watch will be a favorite every Marvel fan will want in their collection. © 2021 MARVEL

products.name: Miles Morales
products.bracelet: Leather, Buckle
products.description: A new Marvel | Citizen Spider-Man watch has swung into town. The Miles Morales timepiece is a stunning showcase for the teen Super Hero and science prodigy from Brooklyn who has the power to produce bio-electrical charges at will. The character’s logo and luminous hands and markers adorn the deep black dial, while the 42mm black IP stainless steel case features distinctive arachnid-style lugs. Red contrast stitches are a striking detail on the black leather strap, and the case back features a colorful insert that encourages you to “Find Your Power.” No need to worry about that with this watch: it’s powered by any light with Citizen’s proprietary Eco-Drive technology and never needs a battery. © 2023 MARVEL

products.name: Avengers Legacy
products.bracelet: Leather, Deployment Clasp with Push Buttons
products.description: Avengers fans, assemble! It’s time to refresh your protecting-the-world wardrobe with a stunning new watch that pays tribute to the elite team of Marvel Super Heroes who come together to defeat evil-doers. The black dial strikingly showcases the iconic “A” crossed with an arrow logo in silver-tone stainless steel that produces a three-dimensional effect, enhanced by surrounding concentric circles that appear to be in motion along with luminous hands and markers. The faceted brushed 42mm case and brown leather strap with contrast stitching elevate the look. Heroes deserve a watch that’s sustainably sustainably powered by any light with Eco-Drive technology and never needs a battery. © 2024 MARVEL

products.name: X-Wing and TIE Fighter
products.bracelet: Leather, Buckle
products.description: In the epic battles in the Star Wars saga, the X-wing and TIE Fighter ships played a crucial role. This new watch showcases the legendary starfighters of the Rebel Alliance as seen through a cockpit screen of the Galactic Empire’s twin ion engine ship on a deep black dial printed in white and neon green with red accents and luminous hands and markers. The commanding 45mm black ion-plated stainless steel case and brown leather strap with studs and top stitching add to the military aesthetic, while the case back is etched with an X-wing approaching the Death Star. It’s also Earth-friendly: sustainably powered by any light with Citizen’s proprietary Eco-Drive technology, this watch never needs a battery.

products.name: Imperial Battle
products.bracelet: Stainless Steel, Fold Over Clasp with Push Buttons
products.description: Two of the most fearsome, ingenious, and lethal creations in the Star Wars saga–the Death Star and TIE Fighters–are the laser focus of this new watch that’s sustainably powered by any light by Eco-Drive technology. Original embossed artwork on the red and black metal dial showcases the menacing spherical space station in intricate detail as the backdrop for a swarm of single-pilot space vehicles, with the Galactic Empire crest at 12 o’clock and also etched on the case back. The angled hexagonal gray IP 42mm stainless steel case echoes the iconic shape of the TIE fighters’ panels. Embodying the theme of humanity vs. technology, the Imperial Battle is considered a cinematic milestone and is captured in all its fearsome power in this new timepiece.

products.name: Black Panther 60th Anniversary
products.bracelet: Silicone, Buckle
products.description: Did you know that T’challa, the King of Wakanda, debuted in a Fantastic Four comic in 1966? We’re celebrating the fan favorite’s 60th Anniversary with a new timepiece that’s sustainably powered by any light with Eco-Drive technology. Design details evoke the visually rich franchise and include a stunning dial with a dimensional pattern and a gold Black Panther mask logo. The black IP 42mm case and silicone strap and purple minute track represent the powerful energy radiated by our hero’s Vibranium suit. Completing the commemoration is the stainless steel case back etched with ‘Black Panther 60 Years.” This super-stylish watch is a fitting tribute to a timeless Marvel icon.

products.name: Luke Skywalker, Jedi Master
products.bracelet: Leather, Buckle
products.description: Powered by light, guided by legend—introducing the latest Luke Skywalker, Jedi Master timepiece that’s sustainably powered by any light with Eco-Drive technology. The dial captures the essence of the farm boy from Tatooine turned redeemer of the Republic, depicting him in a striking silhouette on a black and green background. The hands, markers, and Luke’s iconic green lightsaber are luminous, and the Rebel Alliance starbird appears at 12 o’clock. Engraved on the caseback is Luke’s famous line, “I am a Jedi like my father before me.” The 43mm polished stainless steel case and black leather strap with green stitching and lining add both durability and style. Embark on a thrilling hero’s journey with this epic timepiece.

products.name: Venom "Lethal Protector"
products.bracelet: Polyurethane, Buckle
products.description: Spider-Man’s nemesis has main-character energy in the all-new boxed set devoted to Venom, the alien symbiote with a shape-shifting, liquid-like form and an equally fluid personality. The deep black dial features Venom’s signature teeth in the form of luminous markers along with his own spider symbol, an alternative design of his hosts Peter Parker’s logo, finished by ink-jet lightning. The 42mm black IP stainless steel case and textured polyurethane strap contrast the red second hand and crown at the 4 o’clock position. The case back is etched with his likeness, and the set is completed by a collectible coin that features Spider-Man on one side and his arch-enemy on the other: Super Hero and Anti-Hero. Contrary to Venom’s dark side, this watch is powered by any light with Eco-Drive technology and never needs a battery. © 2025 MARVEL

products.name: Tony Stark '63
products.bracelet: Leather, Buckle
products.description: Sophistication fuses with technology in the latest Marvel’s Tony Stark timepiece from Citizen. Featuring the iconic shapes of the Arc Reactor on its dial, the action-ready watch reflects the Super Hero's ingenuity and the technological edge of Stark Industries on the wrist. With up to 100 meters of water resistance, this hardwearing timepiece is as robust in functionality as its design indicates. A geometric, black IP case and a matching black leather strap with contrast stitching secure the timepiece, while on the dial, gold-tone and fiery red details further channel Tony Stark's signature aesthetic and suit of Iron Man armor. Like the iconic power source in Iron Man's mechanized suit of armor, Citizen’s Eco-Drive technology drives the watch, ensuring its continuous and sustainable operation by making use of any light source to eliminate the need for a battery. © 2023 MARVEL

products.name: Stark, Kinda Sorta Famous
products.bracelet: Leather, Buckle
products.description: “Heroes aren’t born, they’re built,” Tony Stark informs us. The CEO of Stark Industries and one of the original Avengers vaulted to the top of the Super Hero ecosystem when he engineered his famous exoskeleton suit. With an ingenious design by legendary comic book artist Adam Kubert to match his genius subject, the dial features Stark in his flying mode looking as though he’s going to shatter the watch’s crystal, with the dial’s hands, markers, arc reactor, and sky trail behind him illuminated. The bold 43mm black IP stainless steel case is complemented by a perforated black leather strap with red contrast stitching. The case back is etched with his business card for a witty touch, and the set is completed by a collectible pin. Stark himself would be impressed that this watch is sustainably powered by any light with Citizen’s proprietary Eco-Drive technology and never needs a battery. © 2025 MARVEL

products.name: X-Men
products.bracelet: Leather, Buckle
products.description: It’s time to get excited! The Marvel's X-Men watch has landed to level up your style game to Omega–plus. As an extra bonus, it’s sustainably powered by any light with Eco-Drive technology and never needs a battery. Housed in a 42mm silver-tone stainless steel case, the double-layered black dial is dominated by an eye-catching silver “X” within a silver ring, plus pops of color that evoke the Blue and Gold Teams. The textured black leather strap features a yellow edging detail, and the stainless steel caseback is etched with the X-Men logo. Tap into your mutant abilities and help save the world with this extraordinary new timepiece.

products.name: Ahsoka Tano
products.bracelet: Leather, Buckle
products.description: It’s time for Anakin Skywalker’s former Jedi apprentice, Ahsoka Tano, to take center stage with this new watch designed to celebrate her strength and power. A unisex 40.5mm stainless steel round case encircles a striking blue dial featuring abstract patterning and her signature face markings that are fully luminous along with raised diamond-shaped markers echoing details from her headdress. The case back is etched with a her unique likeness, and the timepiece is finished with a combat-ready rugged brown calf leather strap with sport buckle. And like the Star Wars™ saga, this watch is fueled by light with Eco-Drive technology and never needs a battery.

products.name: Death Star 2
products.bracelet: Stainless Steel, Fold Over Clasp with Push Buttons
products.description: That’s no moon, that’s a space station!” This imposing watch from the men’s classic Star Wars™ | Citizen collection, the Death Star 2, features the intimidating Death Star on a black and white two-tone accented dial. This new timepiece has 3 hands that appear as lightsabers™ accentuating with a glow of destiny. The luminous face highlights the X-wing fighter, and the 12 and 6 markers are angled to evoke the famous opening crawl of the Star Wars films, while the uniquely designed dial creates a domed effect giving the illusion that it is a 3D image. The angular black IP case surrounds the Death Star with many luminous details. The stainless-steel black bracelet fastens with a fold over clasp with push buttons and illustration of the Death Star is depicted on the case back with the Star Wars logo. This technological terror of a timepiece is powered by Eco-Drive technology and never needs a battery; it is powered by any “galactic” light source.

products.name: Drive
products.bracelet: Leather, Buckle
products.description: The Drive from Citizen collection. A collection of watches with simple classically modern designed cases all powered by Citizen's Eco Drive Technology. These watches are powered by light and will never need a battery change. Featured here with rose gold-tone stainless steel case, brown strap and dark grey dial with rose gold-tone accents. Featuring our Eco-Drive technology – powered by light, any light. Never needs a battery. Caliber number E111.

products.name: Drive
products.bracelet: Stainless Steel, Sliding Clasp
products.description: A clean, simple design and uncluttered details; this brand new intriguing timepiece will keep you going for years to come. Powered by light, with Eco-Drive technology, this maintenance free timepiece will never need a battery change. Featured here in a black-tone stainless steel case, black-tone Milanese mesh bracelet, black dial and black accents. Caliber number E111.

products.name: Millennium Falcon Hyperdrive
products.bracelet: Stainless Steel, Fold Over Clasp with Push Buttons
products.description: Feel as if you’re joining the Rebel Alliance when you sport the Millennium Falcon Hyperdrive with a hyper-contemporary design that shines a spotlight on the iconic light freighter piloted by Han Solo and Chewbacca. The black dial depicts “the fastest hunk of junk in the galaxy,” with a dramatic simulation of hyperdrive seen through the cockpit window and an image of the ship surrounding the date window. The silver-tone hands and markers feature luminous fill for ultimate legibility, while the brushed silver-tone stainless steel case and bracelet make a sleek style statement. The case back is adorned with the Star Wars™ logo and an etching of the powerful Millennium Falcon—and the watch itself is sustainably powered by any light with Citizen’s proprietary Eco-Drive technology and never needs a battery.

products.name: Hulk, Green Goliath
products.bracelet: Stainless Steel, Fold Over Clasp with Push Buttons
products.description: Evergreen favourite the Hulk is a smash on this new watch showcasing the mild-mannered science genius Dr. Bruce Banner, whose alter-ego is the rage-fueled Avenger. The black dial centers the Hulk in a classic pose anchoring green lume-filed hands and a purple second hand and surrounded by abstractions of the gamma rays that initially transformed him into the super-sized, super-strong Goliath, while the gamma ray icon surrounds the date window. The sturdy 42mm case and bracelet are crafted from black IP stainless steel, and the case back is etched with his logo and his mighty fist. Another sign of strength? This watch is sustainably powered by any light with our Eco-Drive technology and never needs a battery. © 2025 MARVEL

products.name: Promaster Dive
products.bracelet: Stainless Steel, Safety Fold Over Clasp with Push Buttons
products.description: Good looks meet dive-ready functionality in the latest Promaster Dive timepiece. Comfortable on the wrist at 41mm in silver-tone stainless steel, this handsome tool watch is secured to the wrist via a matching triple-link bracelet and stylized in wear via a blue unidirectional bezel. The gradient blue dial hosts the highly visible applied hour markers, with plenty of lume and a unique handset easily showcases the time no matter the lighting conditions. A subtle date window at the 3 o'clock position provides daily utility. Featuring our Eco-Drive technology – sustainably powered by light, any light. Never needs a battery. This high-performance watch includes a wetsuit extender that doubles as a tool-less micro adjust, is ISO compliant and water resistant up to 200 meters, and comes in an exclusive dive tank box. Caliber number E168.

products.name: Drive
products.bracelet: Leather, Buckle
products.description: The Drive from Citizen collection. A collection of watches with simple classically modern design, all powered by Eco-Drive Technology. Watches powered by any light and never need a battery change. Featured here in stainless steel case, caramel brown leather strap with a navy blue dial, day and date. Featuring our Eco-Drive technology – powered by light, any light. Never needs a battery. Caliber number 8725.

products.name: C-3PO Rewired
products.bracelet: Leather, Buckle
products.description: The humanoid robot spoke the first line of dialogue—“Did you hear that?”—to R2-D2 in 1977 and appeared in all nine films of the Star Wars ™ saga, cementing his role as a cinema icon. A new watch pays tribute to Threepio with distinctively droid-like details including sub dials that resemble his “eyes” and patterns that evoke his complex circuitry on the striking yellow and black dial that includes luminous hands and markers. The gold-tone stainless steel 42mm case evokes his metal plating, the black leather dials features colourful stitching that echoes the circuit imagery on the dial, and his likeness is etched on the case back. This watch is sustainably powered by any light with Citizen’s proprietary Eco-Drive technology and never needs a battery.

products.name: Captain America Forever
products.bracelet: CORDURA®, Buckle
products.description: Since 1940, Captain America has served as a shining beacon of liberty and determination. The story of the first Avenger continues to captivate fans worldwide. And just as you’d choose the ultimate patriot to lead your team of Avengers, you’ll want Cap’s rugged new watch on your wrist. The military-inspired black dial with luminous printing and hands features a symbol of his strength—his iconic Vibranium alloy shield—on the sub-dial. The 40mm stainless steel case and dark gray Cordura nylon cuff band are built to last, and the case back showcases the Captain America logo to remind you that freedom is always worth fighting for. Sustainably powered by any light with Eco-Drive technology, this watch never needs a battery. © 2024 MARVEL

products.name: Tsuki-Yomi A-T
products.bracelet: Super Titanium, Fold Over Clasp with Push Buttons
products.description: When breakthrough technology and spectacular design meet, the Tsuki-Yomi A-T is reading the moon. It’s the world’s first moonphase watch combined with atomic timekeeping innovation from Citizen, and this model is nothing short of impressive. The styling embodies the moon’s surface and a window at 6 o’clock displays the current moon phase. The timepiece measures 43mm in a silver-tone Super Titanium™ case, where sharp faceted edges pair with an elevated design throughout for an eye-catching aesthetic on the wrist. The deep purple dial works in tandem with black accents and silver-tone touches for a display that’s as handsome as it is legible. In addition to its running time, the watch features a moon phase display, world time in 24 time zones, a perpetual calendar, and a day-date functionality. Powered by Citizen’s proprietary Eco-Drive technology to provide light-powered vitality without ever needing a battery. Water resistant up to 100 meters. Caliber H874.

products.name: Rebel Pilot
products.bracelet: Leather, Buckle
products.description: From a long time ago in a galaxy far, far away comes the new men’s watch the Rebel Pilot, from Citizen’s Star Wars™ collection. This timepiece features a 44mm black chronograph dial with 1/5 second chronograph that measures up to 60 minutes, 12/24-hour time, tachymeter and date. The watch dial showcases essential Rebel symbols; the helmet, X-Fighter and the Rebellion logo to remind you of the significance of the mission. The markers, hands, and the X-fighter jet are luminous, while the hands replicate the iconic light sabers. The silver-tone stainless steel case and orange leather buckle strap, which accents the Rebel’s colors, complete this ultimate Star Wars™ look. Powered by Eco-Drive technology, this watch never needs a battery. The case back further emphasizes the Rebel Pilot’s classic expression, “May the Force Be with You” etched over the Rebel fighter logo. products.description: Functional and practical, modern and sporty –– the new Citizen Series8 880 GMT is the perfect companion for daily wear to spirited travel, and everything in between. Etched on the case back is Mickey Mouse’s suitcase with two destination stickers — a fun easter egg for the collector who is following Mickey Mouse’s journey. Surrounding the case back design are the words “Time to Fly” and “Since 1928”— marking the year Mickey Mouse first debuted on the silver screen. Another reason to say “oui, oui” to this watch? Featuring a two-tone accented dial, bright crystals and date feature. Featuring our Eco-Drive technology – powered by light, any light. Never needs a battery. Caliber number E013.

products.name: Sport Luxury
products.bracelet: Stainless Steel, Fold Over Clasp
products.description: When sporty style meets luxury, you get this latest stunner from Citizen. Joining ready-for-anything wearability with feminine elegance, this time-and-date timepiece is the ultimate day-to-evening watch to wear. The silver-tone stainless steel case measures 33mm in diameter and is presented on a silver-tone, 3-link stainless steel bracelet for a sleek, versatile wear on the wrist. The radiant blue dial is characterized by its highly legible style and diamond accents, elevating the sporty wearer one step further. A water resistance up to 100 meters helps the dynamic watch maintain a host of functionality without compromising its alluring appearance. Powered by Citizen’s proprietary Eco-Drive technology to provide light-powered vitality continuously and sustainably without ever needing a battery. Caliber E013.

products.name: Corso Diamond
products.bracelet: Stainless Steel, Fold Over Clasp with Push Buttons
products.description: A classic timepiece is always in style in the Corso ladies' watch from Citizen, now with added touch of sparkle. Featuring a diamond-accented bezel on a silver-tone stainless steel bracelet and 28mm case and matching bracelet, and a 3-hand taupe dial and date indicator, luminous hands, and applied indices – this elegant timepiece also has a fold-over clasp closure with hidden push buttons and is water resistant to 100 meters. If you’re looking for a dress watch to add elevated, diamond-touched style to your wardrobe, look no further – the Corso is the perfect choice. It also uses Citizen’s Eco-Drive technology, so it is sustainably powered by any light and will never need a battery. Caliber E011.

products.name: Belle Diamond
products.bracelet: Stainless Steel, Fold Over Clasp with Push Buttons
products.description: Nothing is more iconic than a Disney Princess, and one of the more famous, Belle from Disney’s Beauty and the Beast, is captured in this ladies’ watch from Citizen. Belle’s signature rose icon is featured on the champagne dial, paired with a gold-tone stainless steel case and bracelet watch band. Engraved on the back is the message “Like a rose, I stand tall,” reminding every woman who wears it to be proud of who they are, just like Belle. The two-hand dial has eight diamond markers to complete the look. In addition, the watch is powered by light with the exclusive Eco-Drive technology. This Disney Princess watch will become a favorite classic for fans of all ages.

products.name: Ariel Diamond
products.bracelet: Stainless Steel, Fold Over Clasp with Push Buttons
products.description: This Citizen watch captures the essence of the Disney Princess who embodies the spirit of forging your own path: Ariel from Disney’s The Little Mermaid. The dark blue dial features the princess herself in a classic silhouette, dreaming of adventures to come. Diamonds round out the dial, designed to add a bit of shimmer to the waves around her. The stainless steel watch case is engraved on the back with “Sea the Real Me,” and a two-tone bracelet band finishes the stylish Eco-Drive, light-powered watch. It is a timeless and elegant timepiece that will be at home in every Disney Princess watch collection.

products.description: Distinctive and elegant on the wrist, the Citizen L Rainell is introduced in a smaller case size, defined by a softly contoured, raindrop-shaped case and refined proportions. Sustainably powered by any light with our proprietary Eco-Drive technology, which never needs a battery, the silver-tone stainless steel design features a five-link bracelet, a clean dial with matching applied indices, and a cabochon-set crown.

products.name: Aloha, Stitch!
products.bracelet: Stainless Steel, Fold Over Clasp with Push Buttons
products.description: We can’t help falling in love with this celebration of Disney Stitch, the extraterrestrial troublemaker who finds himself as part of an unlikely family on Earth. Sustainably powered by any light with Eco-Drive technology, this new watch features original artwork by Disney artists John and Shelley Loter that showcases Stitch on a deep blue pineapple skin-patterned dial, happily holding a pineapple–the symbol of Hawaiian hospitality that also serves as the 12 o’clock marker. The 29mm gold-tone stainless steel case and bracelet elevate the look, and the case back is etched with a pineapple and the Disney logo. Tap into the spirit of Ohana embodied by Experiment 626 and his unshakable bond with Lilo when you sport this irresistible timepiece.

products.name: Dancing Minnie
products.bracelet: Stainless Steel, Fold Over Clasp with Push Buttons
products.description: Put on your boogie shoes and hit the dance floor with the new Disco Minnie women’s watch from Citizen’s Disney Mickey Mouse collection. The blue 3-hand dial with date features exclusive artwork by character designer and illustrator Jeff Shelly depicting Minnie cutting loose on the dance floor as she bumps the 9 marker and under a twinkling disco ball. Crystal markers surround the dial adding even more sparkle. The silver-tone stainless steel bracelet fastens with a fold over clasp with push buttons. The watch is powered by Eco-Drive technology, which harnesses light to keep you on time and on the beat.

products.name: Cinderella
products.bracelet: Stainless Steel, Fold Over Clasp with Push Buttons
products.description: The perfect accessory to match an elegant pair of glass slippers is the Disney Princess Cinderella Box Set from Citizen, complete with a dreamy timepiece and special collectible pin. The silver-tone stainless steel case and bracelet frame the colorful dial, which displays an illustration of Cinderella losing her famed glass slipper on the palace steps as she leaves the ball. As soon as the clock strikes midnight, Cinderella rushes home, a crucial element of her story that is depicted using a clock that is always set to midnight at the 12 o’clock hour position. Truly channeling Cinderella’s sparkle, the bezel of the watch is set with 78 crystals, while crystal hour markers placed at 3, 6, and 9 o’clock glimmer on the dial. The unique case back reads, “A dream is a wish your heart makes.” Sustainably powered by any light with Citizen’s proprietary Eco-Drive technology, this stylish watch never needs a battery.

products.name: Belle and Beast
products.bracelet: Stainless Steel, Fold Over Clasp with Push Buttons
products.description: The tale as old as time brings a ladies’ watch fit for a beauty, the captivating new Beauty and Beast box set from Citizen’s Disney Princess collection. The set includes a watch with a gold-tone stainless steel case encircled by a sparkling crystal bezel, a 3-hand scalloped detailed mother-of-pearl dial, crystal markers and gold-tone minute markers surrounding the dancing silhouettes of Beauty and the Beast. The gold-tone stainless steel bracelet fastens with a fold-over clasp and push buttons. Powered by Eco-Drive technology, this watch never needs a battery. The case back features a delicate etching of a rose inside a bell jar and the inscription reads, “Open your heart to new adventures.” The set finishes off with a charming pin of a bell jar containing a rose in yellow and rose gold-tone surrounded by crystals. Even stuffy Cogsworth would declare this box set positively enchanting.

products.name: Frozen
products.bracelet: Stainless Steel, Fold Over Clasp with Push Buttons
products.description: Bring the charm of Arendelle to your wrist with the latest Disney Frozen Box Set from Citizen, complete with a dazzling timepiece and special collectible pin of a snowflake. The Frozen watch features a silver-tone stainless steel case and matching polished bracelet, channeling a snowy design inspired by the fearless Elsa. The azure dial is decorated with cool blues and a delicate snowflake pattern reminiscent of Elsa’s ice palace, with crystals shimmering like ice for each hour. The snow-inspired watch is powered by Citizen’s proprietary Eco-Drive technology, never requiring a battery. The design is made complete by a unique case back inscribed with the message "Nature is Magical.”

products.name: Minnie Mouse
products.bracelet: Stainless Steel, Fold Over Clasp with Push Buttons
products.description: A glossy black dial and sleek stainless-steel case set the perfect backdrop for a charming yet classic Minnie Mouse Citizen timepiece. A playful Minnie Mouse stands proudly at the 6 o’clock mark, bringing a playful spark to the clean, modern design. Powered by Eco-Drive light energy, this timepiece runs on sustainable energy, so the fun never fades. The result is a bright, feel-good everyday classic that delivers Disney magic with a refined twist.

products.name: Aladdin 30th Anniversary
products.bracelet: Leather, Buckle
products.description: Fit for your favorite princess, the Jasmine for Aladdin’s 30th Anniversary ladies’ watch box set from Citizen’s Disney Princess Collection is the perfect way to mark all of today’s special moments. The elegant timepiece features filigree detailing on the gold-tone stainless steel case’s edge-to-edge crystal and the lustrous mother-of-pearl dial. The 2-hand dial with date features Genie’s lamp marking 6 o’clock, a touch of blue crystal adds sparkle to 12 o’clock, and the arabesque scroll print complements the theme. Inscribed on the case back is the iconic saying “Life’s a magic carpet ride.”, providing positive inspiration with every wear. The Jasmine Teal blue leather strap with buckle completes the overall look. Powered by Eco-Drive technology, the watch never needs a battery. The set includes a coordinating jewelry pin, set in gold-tone with a filigree look and accented with blue zircon crystals. Wearing this captivating pair is a delightful way to remember the wisdom of Genie, that “today’s special moments are tomorrow’s memories.”

products.name: Aurora Enchanted
products.bracelet: Stainless Steel, Fold Over Clasp with Push Buttons
products.description: Embody the timeless allure of Disney’s Princess Aurora, aka Sleeping Beauty, with this sumptuous new boxed set. The pink mother-of-pearl dial is a work of art, featuring a rose-gold hued floral border with a crown at the top, four crystal markers, and gold-tone decorative hands. The focal point is a lovely portrait of the Disney princess holding a rose after being awakened by a kiss from Prince Philip. The 30mm brushed silver-tone stainless steel case and bracelet add contrast, and the specially packaged set is completed with a stunning collectible crown pin. As befits the nature-loving Aurora, the watch is sustainably powered by any light with Eco-Drive technology and never needs a battery. © 2024 DISNEY

products.name: Belle, Eternal Beauty
products.bracelet: Leather, Buckle
products.description: Featuring a bookish beauty, a prince under a beastly spell, and an amusing entourage of palace servants, “Disney’s Beauty and the Beast,” has captivated audiences worldwide since its debut in 1991. A new watch from the Disney Princess Collection is as lovely as Belle herself, featuring a shimmering mother-of-pearl dial designed by Disney artists John and Shelley Loter that showcases crystals and rose gold-tone filigree roses and hands. A faceted rose gold-tone stainless steel case and the chiffon-pink leather strap add to its allure, and the case back is etched with a profile of our heroine holding the enchanted rose. This elegant timepiece is powered by any light with Citizen’s Eco-Drive technology and never needs a battery.
